_description: Tracks the periodic check of upstream OpenClaw stable releases. See CLAUDE.md decision #40. Updated by Claude every 48h.
assessmentNotes: v0.9.8 bumps baseline 2026.5.7 → 2026.5.18 (operator-authorized): all five tags in package.json's openclaw section now read 2026.5.18, devDependencies.openclaw upgraded, typecheck + tests + lint + build all green against the new SDK. Two-pass CLI loader fixed via cli-metadata.js (decision #58). contextTokenBudget / resolvedRef / harnessId / tool-ctx channelId integrated (decision #59). 11 new lifecycle hooks subscribed (subagent / agent.run / agent.finalize / session reset / model resolve / cron / heartbeat / inbound claim / message dispatch). v0.9.3's decision #40 description previously misplaced these fields under openclaw.plugin.json — v0.9.8 corrects the docs.
